1	# ClipCast — One video is worth a thousand words
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	ClipCast is a free screen recorder and async video messaging platform that helps teams communicate faster with AI-powered video creation, editing, and sharing. Built for professionals, remote teams, and enterprises seeking modern async communication tools.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #1868DB (primary blue), #FF613D (accent orange), #292A2E (dark text)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: One video is worth a thousand words
    10	Subtitle: Easily record and share AI-powered video messages with your teammates and customers to supercharge productivity
    11	CTA: "Get ClipCast for free" | "Install Chrome Extension"
    12	
    13	## Social Proof
    14	Millions of people across 400,000 companies choose ClipCast
    15	Trusted by: Stripe · Dropbox · HubSpot · Atlassian · Launchdarkly · Netflix
    16	
    17	## Feature: AI Bug Reports
    18	Label: New!
    19	Title: Ship faster with AI bug reports
    20	Description: Record a quick walkthrough and let ClipCast's AI turn it into a fully populated Jira work item in a few clicks. ClipCast automatically captures the technical details devs need (device/browser/OS, console errors, and network activity) to pinpoint the problem fast and move work forward.
    21	CTA: "Learn more"
    22	
    23	## Feature: Screen Recorder
    24	Title: The easiest screen recorder you'll ever use
    25	Subtitle: Record in a few clicks. Share anywhere. Collaborate better.
    26	Subsection Title: Lightning fast screen recording
    27	Description: Easily record your screen and camera. Record on any device using ClipCast's Chrome extension, desktop app, or mobile app.
    28	CTA: "Download now"
    29	
    30	## Feature: Video Editor
    31	Title: So much more than a screen recorder
    32	- **Edit your videos like a pro** — ClipCast's intuitive editor lets you trim, stitch clips, add eye-catching backgrounds, and even enhance your message with text, arrows, and box overlays. The result? Engaging videos you can deliver fast.
    33	- **Share or embed video anywhere you work** — From Google Workspace to Slack, ClipCast videos seamlessly integrate with hundreds of tools you use every day.
    34	- **Engage and connect with video** — Easily collaborate by adding emojis, comments, tasks and CTAs to your video message. Empower remote teams to communicate better across timezones using transcripts and captions in 50+ languages.
    35	
    36	## Feature: Security
    37	Title: Keep your content safe
    38	Description: Enterprise-grade security to keep your data and your customer's data private and secure. We offer SSO, SCIM as well as custom data retention policies and privacy settings.
    39	CTA: "Learn more"
    40	
    41	## Enterprise Security
    42	- GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant
    43	- Built on the AWS-backbone with secure and reliable infrastructure
    44	- Equipped with advanced admin controls to protect sensitive information internally
    45	- Secured with encrypted data and industry-standard security frameworks
    46	
    47	## Use Cases
    48	Title: Video messaging for all use cases
    49	- **Sales** — Personalize your pitch with video outreach to close more deals.
    50	- **Engineering** — Add visual context to your code to accelerate your sprints.
    51	- **Customer support** — Troubleshoot over video to reach resolutions faster.
    52	- **Design** — Share ideas and provide feedback over video to enhance designs.
    53	CTA: "See all use cases"
    54	
    55	## Features Grid
    56	Title: Powerful features for easy, custom recordings
    57	- Screen and camera recording
    58	- Easy sharing and embedding
    59	- Trim and stitch video clips
    60	- Download and upload
    61	- Transcriptions and closed captions
    62	- Video privacy controls
    63	- Custom background
    64	- Video and viewer insights
    65	CTA: "See all features"
    66	
    67	## Enterprise Impact Stats
    68	- **50%** fewer meetings across organizations
    69	- **18%** increase in traffic on webpages with ClipCast videos
    70	- **19%** boost in reply rates across sales outreach
    71	
    72	## Enterprise Async Video Benefits
    73	Title: Communicate faster with async video
    74	- **Save time** — Teams can communicate more efficiently without typing long emails, scheduling meetings, or trying to work across time zones.
    75	- **Communicate clearly** — Async video captures context, tone, and personality in detail. Distributed teams can preserve the true meaning of their message.
    76	- **Deepen culture** — Make it effortless for anyone in your organization to share ideas, introduce themselves, and build community with fellow teammates using async video.
    77	
    78	## Enterprise Community & Visibility
    79	Title: Drive community and visibility at scale
    80	- **Scale knowledge with video** — Connect pockets of institutional knowledge by making video messages searchable and discoverable.
    81	- **Create a culture of sharing** — Video messaging encourages your team to share early and often so projects are visible and driven to completion quicker.
    82	- **Build community at scale** — Magnify people's voices so the whole company can feel connected and heard beyond the boundaries of their team.
    83	
    84	## Pricing Plans
    85	Title: Choose the plan that fits your needs.
    86	Toggle: Monthly / Annually (SAVE UP TO 17%)
    87	Slider: Team size
    88	
    89	| Plan | Starter | Business | Business + AI | Enterprise |
    90	|------|---------|----------|---------------|------------|
    91	| Price | $0 | $18/user/mo | $24/user/mo | Contact Sales |
    92	| Label | — | — | MOST POPULAR | — |
    93	| CTA | Sign up | Try for free | Try for free | Contact Sales |
    94	
    95	**Starter highlights:** 25 videos, 5 min screen recordings, unlimited meeting length, transcriptions in 50+ languages
    96	**Business highlights:** Everything in Starter + unlimited videos, unlimited recording, basic waveform editing, remove branding, upload & download
    97	**Business + AI highlights:** Everything in Business + auto-video enhancement, advanced editing, video-to-text automation, auto-meeting recap emails, auto-meeting notes
    98	**Enterprise highlights:** Everything in Business + AI + advanced security (SSO, SCIM), Salesforce integration, 99.95% uptime SLA, admin insights
    99	
   100	## Pricing Comparison Table
   101	
   102	| Feature | Starter | Business | Business + AI | Enterprise |
   103	|---------|---------|----------|---------------|------------|
   104	| Members | Up to 50 | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |

   119	| Salesforce integration | — | — | — | Included |
   120	| Priority support | — | Included | Included | Included |
   121	| Dedicated account manager | — | — | — | Included |
   122	
   123	## AI Features Highlight
   124	Title: ClipCast AI
   125	Subtitle: Just hit record and ClipCast AI will do the rest. Instant edits, enhancements, and recaps for all your video recordings.
   126	Features: Auto-meeting notes (NEW), Auto-meeting recaps (NEW), Video-to-text automation, Variables (NEW), Auto-titles & summaries, Filler word removal
   127	CTA: "Try for free"
   128	
   129	## FAQ
   130	- **Can I start a free trial of paid plans?** — Yes, you can try our Business + AI plan free for 14 days. If you would like a free 14-day trial of our Enterprise plan please contact sales.
   131	- **Why should I consider getting ClipCast Business + AI?** — The ClipCast AI suite reduces time spent packaging and sharing videos after recording. 67% of users do not edit the auto-generated title. 73% of people said it is "extremely or very valuable" to their workflows. 18% more viewer engagement with AI-enhanced videos.
   132	- **What enterprise-grade security features does ClipCast offer?** — Enforced single sign-on (SSO), SCIM automated user provisioning, organization audit log, and advanced admin controls are included in the Enterprise plan.
   133	- **What are my payment options?** — You can be billed monthly, but save 17% if you pay annually. We accept credit card payment; for ACH, reach out to our Sales team.
   134	
   135	## Blog Teasers
   136	- **When to Choose Synchronous Vs. Asynchronous Communication** — This guide explores the intricacies of sync vs. async communication, helps you decide which is best for your workflow, and introduces how screen recording bridges the gap.
   137	- **Let ClipCast AI Do the Work: Say Goodbye to Manual Documentation** — With new ClipCast AI workflows, you turn any video into a written doc to draft SOPs, file Jira tickets, and more.
   138	
   139	## Enterprise CTA Block
   140	Title: ClipCast for Enterprise
   141	Subtitle: ClipCast for Enterprise helps teams securely manage and organize async video communication at scale
   142	CTA: "Learn more"
   143	
   144	## Testimonials
   145	- "ClipCast enables us to maximize our impact as a distributed company by helping us collaborate and share ideas more easily." — **Andrew Reynolds**, Design Lead, MetaLab
   146	- "I think it's the plug-and-play, intuitive, frictionless nature of ClipCast that allows us to create personalized videos so quickly and see such an impressive increase in our response rate." — **Bucky Henry**, Sales Manager, Intercom
   147	- "ClipCast allows me to connect more personally with people without having to do 75 different one-on-one calls, which is just impossible at scale." — **Katie Burke**, Chief People Officer, HubSpot
   148	- "My teammates and I love using ClipCast! It has saved us hundreds of hours by creating informative video tutorials instead of long emails or 1-on-1 trainings with customers." — **Erica Goodell**, Customer Success, Pearson
   149	- "ClipCast gave us an affordable platform to create personalized video content from our laptops, without the need for expensive video production teams." — **Chris Radtke**, Sr Director of Content Marketing, Braze
   150	- "I've sent ClipCasts externally three times this month instead of scheduling a meeting and the first response is always, 'This is great, why don't more people do this?'" — **Colby Howard**, Founding Partner, Paragon Intel

    20	---
    21	
    22	# Web Design Expert
    23	
    24	Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.
    25	
    26	## When to Use This Skill
    27	
    28	**Use for:**
    29	- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
    30	- Color palette creation and rationale
    31	- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
    32	- Component visual design (not just code)
    33	- Responsive design strategy
    34	- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements
    35	
    36	**Do NOT use for:**
    37	- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
    38	- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
    39	- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
    40	- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
    41	- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**
    42	
    43	## Core Design Process
    44	
    45	### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)
    46	
    47	```
    48	BUSINESS CONTEXT:
    49	- What is the primary goal?
    50	- Who is the target audience?
    51	- What action should users take?
    52	- Who are competitors?
    53	
    54	BRAND PERSONALITY:
    55	- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
    56	- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
    57	- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
    58	```
    59	
    60	### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)
    61	
    62	Each concept includes:
    63	- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
    64	- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
    65	- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
    66	- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
    67	- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)
    68	
    69	## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard
    70	
    71	**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**
    72	
    73	OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
    74	- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
    75	- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
    76	- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)
    77	
    78	```css
    79	/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
    80	--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
    81	--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
    82	--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
    83	--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
    84	```
    85	
    86	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
    87	| Resource | Purpose |
    88	|----------|---------|
    89	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
    90	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
    91	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |
    92	
    93	**When presenting color palettes:**
    94	```
    95	Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
    96	Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
    97	Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
    98	```
    99	
   100	Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.
   101	
   102	### 3. Design Principles
   103	
   104	**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?
   105	
   106	**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?
   107	
   108	## Common Anti-Patterns
   109	
   110	### Design by Committee
   111	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   112	|--------------------|----------------|
   113	| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
   114	| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |
   115	
   116	### Decoration Over Function
   117	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   118	|--------------------|----------------|
   119	| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
   120	| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |
   121	
   122	### Ignoring the Fold
   123	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   124	|--------------------|----------------|
   125	| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
   126	| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |
   127	
   128	### Low Contrast Text
   129	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   130	|--------------------|----------------|
   131	| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
   132	| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |
   133	
   134	### Mobile as Afterthought
   135	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   136	|--------------------|----------------|
   137	| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
   138	| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |
   139	
   140	## Design Trend Evolution
   141	
   142	| Era | Trend |
   143	|-----|-------|
   144	| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
   145	| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
   146	| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |
   147	
   148	**Watch For** (dated patterns LLMs may suggest):
   149	- Flat design without depth
   150	- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
   151	- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
   152	- Desktop hamburger menus
   153	
   154	## Output Deliverables
   155	
   156	1. **Brand Identity Guide**: Colors, typography, voice, do's/don'ts
   157	2. **Design Specifications**: Spacing, radius, shadows, animation timing
   158	3. **Component Examples**: Buttons, forms, cards, navigation (all states)
   159	4. **Responsive Guidelines**: Breakpoints, layout changes, touch targets
   160	
   161	## MCP Tools
   162	
   163	| Tool | Purpose |
   164	|------|---------|
   165	| `21st_magic_component_inspiration` | Search UI patterns for inspiration |
   166	| `21st_magic_component_builder` | Generate React/Tailwind components |
   167	| `21st_magic_component_refiner` | Improve existing component UI |
   168	| `logo_search` | Get company logos in JSX/TSX/SVG |
   169	
   170	## Integration with Other Skills
   171	
   172	Paired skills are bundled at `paired-skills/` in this skill directory. Read the corresponding SKILL.md when you need deeper expertise:
   173	
   174	| Skill | Path | Use For |
   175	|-------|------|---------|
   176	| **typography-expert** | `typography-expert/SKILL.md` | Deep typography decisions, font pairing, OpenType features |
   177	| **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert** | `color-theory-palette-harmony-expert/SKILL.md` | Color science, palette harmony, perceptual color spaces |
   178	| **design-system-creator** | `design-system-creator/SKILL.md` | Design tokens, CSS architecture, component libraries |
   179	| **vibe-matcher** | `vibe-matcher/SKILL.md` | Translating emotional vibes to visual DNA |
   180	| **design-archivist** | `design-archivist/SKILL.md` | Building visual databases, competitive research |
   181

   187	| `references/color-accessibility.md` | Palettes, psychology, dark mode, WCAG compliance |

steps.message:
All 5 pages for the ClipCast landing site have been built and verified. Here's a summary of what was delivered to `/app/output/`:

### Files Created
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Home page with 15 sections: hero, logo bar, AI bug reports, screen recorder, video editor, integrations, engagement, security, use cases, features grid, blog teasers, enterprise CTA, testimonials, CTA banner, footer |
| `enterprise.html` | Enterprise page: hero, logo bar, async video benefits, community & visibility, testimonial quote, security, use cases grid, stats, integrations, pricing plans, testimonials carousel, CTA banner, footer |
| `pricing.html` | Pricing page: hero, billing toggle (monthly/annual with "save up to 17%" badge), team size slider, 4 plan cards, AI features highlight, full comparison table, FAQ accordion, logo bar, CTA banner, footer |
| `login.html` | Login page with social auth (Google, Slack, Apple, Outlook, SSO) + email form |
| `signup.html` | Signup page with Google social auth + email form, testimonial sidebar |
| `styles.css` | Shared design system with OKLCH colors, typography, components, and responsive breakpoints |

### Key Interactions Implemented
- **Pricing billing toggle** — switches between monthly and annual prices (~17% savings)
- **Team size slider** — dynamically updates per-plan totals in the card descriptions
- **FAQ accordion** — click to expand/collapse answers
- **Cookie consent banner** — accept/reject with manage-preferences modal containing category toggles (Targeting, Functional, Performance)
- **Auth forms** — email input with simulated flow via alert

### Navigation Verified
All inter-page links work correctly: Home ↔ Enterprise ↔ Pricing ↔ Login ↔ Signup, with CTA buttons routing to signup as specified.
